## Checklist

- [ ] TV **and** web: the change exists on both, with the same wording and order (or this PR says why not).
- [ ] Nothing is deleted or overwritten on a user's console, disk or NAS without an explicit confirmation.
- [ ] A running game is never touched.
- [ ] User-facing text is in `build-system/changelog.json` (new / improved / fixed), in plain words.
- [ ] New third-party code is GPL-3.0-compatible and added to `engine2/web/credits.json`.
- [ ] `python3 build-system/build.py --clean` builds; tested on a real console (say which firmware family and storage).
